title: Optimizing the white light emission in the solid state isatin and thiazole based molecular hybrids by introduction of variety of substituents on isatin and thiazole ring systems
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7973-7986
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09010A, Paper

Sultana Shaik, Rama Mohana Reddy Sirigireddy, Sai Teja Talari, Haranath Divi, Naveen Mulakayala, Venkatramu Vemula, Chinna Gangi Reddy Nallagondu
Citric acid catalyzed 3-component reaction strategy has been developed for the synthesis of multi-colour emissive isatin–thiazole based fluorophores (4) from isatins (1), thiosemicarbazide (2) and α-bromoketones (3) in ethanol under reflux conditions.
